description: This Java class implements a Spring Batch Tasklet responsible for processing loans that have pending income posting transactions. It retrieves loan IDs, attempts to add income posting and accruals for each, logs errors if any, and throws an exception if errors occur during processing.

classes.name: AddPeriodicAccrualEntriesForLoansTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch tasklet that processes loans with pending income posting transactions by adding income posting and accrual entries.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked during batch job execution; retrieves loan IDs with pending income posting transactions, processes each, logs errors, and raises exceptions if necessary.
